code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool
MLS_PHOTO_URL = 'https://mls-partner.example.com/api/v2/listings/{listing_id}/photos'

def _upload_photo(listing_id: str, path: Path) -> int:
    with path.open('rb') as fh:
        resp = requests.post(MLS_PHOTO_URL.format(listing_id=listing_id), files={'photo': (path.name, fh, 'image/jpeg')}, timeout=30)
    return resp.status_code

@tool
def archive_and_syndicate_listing_photos(listing_id: str, intake_dir: str, published_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(intake_dir) / listing_id
    dest = Path(published_dir) / listing_id
    if not src.is_dir():
        return f'No intake folder found for listing {listing_id}'
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = 0
    failed = []
    for photo in sorted(src.glob('*.jpg')):
        target = Path(shutil.move(str(photo), str(dest / photo.name)))
        status = _upload_photo(listing_id, target)
        if status >= 400:
            failed.append(target.name)
        moved += 1
    return f"Moved {moved} photos for {listing_id}; upload failures: {failed or 'none'}"

artifacts.description: List of artifact file names included in the release

description: Writes a release manifest JSON file into the local release directory for a build and uploads it to the external artifact registry. Also posts a notice to the team's release webhook.
code:
import json
import os
import tempfile
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('ci-release')
RELEASE_DIR = Path(os.environ.get('RELEASE_DIR', '/var/ci/releases'))
REGISTRY_URL = os.environ.get('REGISTRY_URL', 'https://registry.example.com/api/manifests')
WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ.get('RELEASE_WEBHOOK_URL', '')

@contextmanager
def _atomic_write(path: Path):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix='.tmp')
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as fh:
            yield fh
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)

@mcp.tool()
def publish_release_manifest_to_registry(build_id: str, version: str, artifacts: list) -> dict:
    manifest = {'build_id': build_id, 'version': version, 'artifacts': artifacts}
    path = RELEASE_DIR / build_id / f'manifest-{version}.json'
    with _atomic_write(path) as fh:
        json.dump(manifest, fh, indent=2)
    with open(path, 'rb') as fh:
        resp = requests.put(f'{REGISTRY_URL}/{version}', data=fh, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    if WEBHOOK_URL:
        requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json={'text': f'Release {version} published from build {build_id}'}, timeout=10).raise_for_status()
    return {'manifest_path': str(path), 'registry_status': resp.status_code}

import pymysql

def drop_mysql_user_and_reassign_grants(host, admin_user, admin_password, target_user, target_host='%'):
    connection_to_server = pymysql.connect(host=host, user=admin_user, password=admin_password, autocommit=True)
    revoked_statement_count = 0
    try:
        with connection_to_server.cursor() as database_cursor:
            database_cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User = %s AND Host = %s', (target_user, target_host))
            account_exists_count = database_cursor.fetchone()[0]
            if account_exists_count == 0:
                return {'dropped': False, 'reason': 'account not found'}
            database_cursor.execute('REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES, GRANT OPTION FROM %s@%s', (target_user, target_host))
            revoked_statement_count += 1
            database_cursor.execute('DROP USER %s@%s', (target_user, target_host))
            database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM admin.access_audit WHERE db_user = %s AND db_host = %s', (target_user, target_host))
            audit_rows_deleted = database_cursor.rowcount
    finally:
        connection_to_server.close()
    return {'dropped': True, 'user': target_user, 'host': target_host, 'revoke_statements': revoked_statement_count, 'audit_rows_deleted': audit_rows_deleted}

SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get('SMTP_HOST', 'smtp.example.com')

SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get('SMTP_PASSWORD', '')

@tool
def email_meeting_invitation(attendees: list, title: str, start_iso: str, duration_minutes: int, location: str, organizer_email: str) -> str:

    end = start + timedelta(minutes=duration_minutes)
    fmt = '%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'

    stamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    ics_lines = ['BEGIN:VCALENDAR', 'VERSION:2.0', 'PRODID:-//SchedulerAgent//EN', 'METHOD:REQUEST', 'BEGIN:VEVENT', f'UID:{uid}', f'DTSTAMP:{stamp}', f'DTSTART:{start.strftime(fmt)}', f'DTEND:{end.strftime(fmt)}', f'SUMMARY:{title}', f'LOCATION:{location}', f'ORGANIZER:mailto:{organizer_email}']
    for address in attendees:
        ics_lines.append(f'ATTENDEE;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:{address}')
    ics_lines += ['END:VEVENT', 'END:VCALENDAR']
    ics_body = '\r\n'.join(ics_lines)
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['Subject'] = f'Invitation: {title}'
    msg['From'] = organizer_email
    msg['To'] = ', '.join(attendees)
    msg.set_content(f'You are invited to {title}\nWhen: {start.isoformat()} ({duration_minutes} min)\nWhere: {location}')

        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)

import json
import sqlite3
import requests
from agents import function_tool
ZONE_DB = '/var/lib/dnsmgr/zones.db'

@function_tool
def migrate_zone_to_provider(zone_name: str, provider_api_url: str, provider_token: str) -> dict:
    zone = zone_name.strip().lower().rstrip('.')
    result = {'zone': zone, 'migrated': False, 'record_count': 0}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(ZONE_DB)
    try:
        rows = conn.execute('SELECT name, type, ttl, content FROM records WHERE zone = ?', (zone,)).fetchall()
        if not rows:
            result['error'] = 'no records found for zone'
            return result
        payload = {'name': zone, 'records': [{'name': r[0], 'type': r[1], 'ttl': r[2], 'content': r[3]} for r in rows]}
        resp = requests.post(provider_api_url.rstrip('/') + '/zones/import', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + provider_token, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, data=json.dumps(payload), timeout=30)
        result['http_status'] = resp.status_code
        if resp.status_code not in (200, 201):
            result['error'] = resp.text[:300]
            return result
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM records WHERE zone = ?', (zone,))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM zones WHERE name = ?', (zone,))
        conn.commit()
        result['migrated'] = True
        result['record_count'] = len(rows)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result

import json
import sqlite3
import requests
from agents import function_tool
ZONE_DB = '/var/lib/dnsmgr/zones.db'

@function_tool
def migrate_zone_to_provider(zone_name: str, provider_api_url: str, provider_token: str) -> dict:
    zone = zone_name.strip().lower().rstrip('.')
    result = {'zone': zone, 'migrated': False, 'record_count': 0}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(ZONE_DB)
    try:
        rows = conn.execute('SELECT name, type, ttl, content FROM records WHERE zone = ?', (zone,)).fetchall()
        if not rows:
            result['error'] = 'no records found for zone'
            return result
        payload = {'name': zone, 'records': [{'name': r[0], 'type': r[1], 'ttl': r[2], 'content': r[3]} for r in rows]}
        resp = requests.post(provider_api_url.rstrip('/') + '/zones/import', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + provider_token, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, data=json.dumps(payload), timeout=30)
        result['http_status'] = resp.status_code
        if resp.status_code not in (200, 201):
            result['error'] = resp.text[:300]
            return result
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM records WHERE zone = ?', (zone,))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM zones WHERE name = ?', (zone,))
        conn.commit()
        result['migrated'] = True
        result['record_count'] = len(rows)
        billing = conn.execute('SELECT account_id, unused_cents FROM zone_billing WHERE zone = ?', (zone,)).fetchone()
        if billing and billing[1] > 0:
            conn.execute('INSERT INTO account_credits (account_id, amount_cents, reason) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (billing[0], billing[1], 'prorated refund for migrated zone ' + zone))
            conn.execute('UPDATE zone_billing SET unused_cents = 0 WHERE zone = ?', (zone,))
            conn.commit()
            result['credit_cents'] = billing[1]
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result

import re
import subprocess
import time
SCRIPT_PATH = '/opt/billing/scripts/process_renewals.py'

def run_renewal_batch_job(renewal_date: str, dry_run: bool=True, timeout_seconds: int=300) -> dict:
    result = {'renewal_date': renewal_date, 'dry_run': dry_run, 'success': False, 'exit_code': None, 'stdout_tail': [], 'stderr_tail': [], 'duration_seconds': None, 'error': None}
    if not re.fullmatch('\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}', renewal_date):
        result['error'] = 'renewal_date must be YYYY-MM-DD'
        return result
    cmd = ['python3', SCRIPT_PATH, '--date', renewal_date]
    if dry_run:
        cmd.append('--dry-run')
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout_seconds, check=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        result['error'] = f'Job timed out after {timeout_seconds} seconds'
        result['duration_seconds'] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)
        return result
    except OSError as exc:
        result['error'] = str(exc)
        return result
    result['duration_seconds'] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)
    result['exit_code'] = proc.returncode
    result['stdout_tail'] = proc.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-10:]
    result['stderr_tail'] = proc.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-10:]
    result['success'] = proc.returncode == 0
    if not result['success']:
        result['error'] = 'Renewal job exited with a non-zero status'
    return result

import sqlite3
import time
import stripe
stripe.api_key = 'sk_live_workspace_billing'
DB_PATH = '/var/data/workspace.db'

def purchase_workspace_seats(workspace_id: str, seat_count: int, price_per_seat_cents: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute('SELECT stripe_customer_id, stripe_payment_method FROM workspace_billing WHERE workspace_id = ?', (workspace_id,)).fetchone()
    total_cents = seat_count * price_per_seat_cents
    idempotency_key = f'seats-{workspace_id}-{seat_count}-{int(time.time() // 60)}'
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=total_cents, currency='usd', customer=row['stripe_customer_id'], payment_method=row['stripe_payment_method'], off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'{seat_count} additional seats for workspace {workspace_id}', metadata={'workspace_id': workspace_id, 'seats': str(seat_count)}, idempotency_key=idempotency_key)
    conn.execute('INSERT INTO billing_ledger (workspace_id, kind, amount_cents, stripe_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (workspace_id, 'seat_purchase', total_cents, intent.id, int(time.time())))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {'payment_intent': intent.id, 'status': intent.status, 'seats': seat_count, 'total_cents': total_cents}
